reasoning_content:
The manager-config module includes `managerConfiguration.properties`, `managerWebConfiguration.properties`, etc. — these are the configuration files listed in the guide. There's also a `hale` directory (HALE configuration for INSPIRE PLU transformation).

Alright, let's keep monitoring the build. It's been about 15 minutes now. It should start compiling soon.

action.command: sleep 120; date +%H:%M:%S; du -sh /root/.m2/repository; grep -cE "Building " /workspace/build.log; grep -E "^\[INFO\] Building|^\[INFO\] --- .*:.*:(compile|gwt)" /workspace/build.log | tail -3; grep -E "^\[ERROR\]" /workspace/build.log | head -3
